name: Electric Vehicle Diagnostics
summary:
Electric Vehicle Diagnostics is an immersive VR training application designed exclusively for learners enrolled in the Immersive Learn Electric Vehicle Diagnostics Micro-Credential Program. Through realistic hands-on simulations, learners develop practical skills in electric vehicle inspection, diagnostic testing, fault identification, safety procedures, battery system evaluation, and troubleshooting techniques used in modern EV service environments.
